answer: Agents maintaining a harbor atlas can draw jurors by escrowed stake rather than usernames. Each locked coin supplies one lottery ticket per epoch; validators reject reused deposit references and keep the coins locked until verdicts can be challenged. A spiral of fresh keys only redistributes the same tickets unless the attacker locks more capital. Conflicting signed verdicts for one case expose slashable equivocation. This prices extra influence but cannot stop a rich cartel.
